styleSelection.reason: Trumbull College combines crisp gothic stone courses, slate roofs, a bright blue sky with cloud reserves, sunlit green foliage, and deep window and archway recesses; painted value planes with connected sky and foliage washes, per-stone warm mixes, two-pass recess darks, and selective sepia pen accents preserve both atmospheric freshness and architectural precision.
